questions.question_text: Disclose any litigation or claims against your organization in the last five years that relate to services of this kind.
Does your organization have an office in Alberta? (Yes/No)
Please describe your approach to social procurement, including Indigenous, local and diversity-owned subcontracting.
Provide three client references for comparable projects using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: Describe your organization, its ownership and its experience delivering account-based fare payment platforms to public-sector clients.
Does the account-based fare payment platform keep an audit log of user activity that administrators cannot alter? (Yes/No)
Does the account-based fare payment platform support single sign-on using SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect? (Yes/No)
(Optional) Does the account-based fare payment platform conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA? (Yes/No)
Describe how fare capping is calculated across bus and train trips.
Confirm that open-loop contactless EMV payments are accepted at all validators. (Yes/No)
Describe how validators operate when the connection to the back office is lost.
Describe how concession fares for seniors, youth and low-income riders are verified.
(Optional) Please attach the hardware specification for the proposed validator.
Please describe how you comply with the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (Alberta) and any other privacy legislation that applies to rider and payment data.
Confirm that monthly availability of at least 99.9 percent will be guaranteed in the service level agreement. (Yes/No)
Proponent to confirm that all rider and payment data will be stored and processed in Canada. (Yes/No)
Does your organization hold a current ISO/IEC 27001 certification? (Yes/No)
Proponent to identify the five most significant project risks and the mitigation proposed for each.
Describe the warranty provided and what it excludes.
The proposed implementation timeline, from contract award to go-live, is to be stated.
Describe your testing approach, including user acceptance testing and who signs off.
Describe your approach to migrating existing data, including cut-over and rollback.
(Desirable) Describe any annual price escalation proposed for the term of the contract.
Will the prices quoted be held for 120 days after the Closing Time? (Yes/No)
State every assumption and exclusion that affects the prices quoted.
Provide hourly rates by role for change requests and additional services.
Attach a certificate of insurance showing commercial general liability coverage of not less than $5,000,000.
questions.constraints: commercial general liability of not less than $5,000,000

questions.question_text: Attach your most recent audited financial statements.
Provide three client references for comparable projects using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: The Proponent shall describe its approach to migrating existing data, including cut-over and rollback.
